messages:
Aisha (Finance): NewWave invoice INV-2026-1721 bounced ACH this morning, 46 days past due. Client requested a 3-month ramp plan and asked to pause dunning while we sort. Details below.
BillingBot: Automated: ACH return R01 for INV-2026-1721. Amount $19,950. Due date: 2026-03-30. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-1721
Marco (Account Exec): I chatted with their Head of FP&A. They're between fund closings. Proposed: 3 instalments over 3 months, first payment next week. Want onboarding to continue — big deployment.
Renee (Collections): We'll accept a plan if we get: (1) signed addendum, (2) payment method on file with autopay, (3) first installment authorization up front. We can pause outward dunning but keep internal reminders. No fee waiver until payment clears.
Samir (Finance Director): Approve conditional 3-month plan provided first payment clears within 5 business days and autopay is active. We won't waive the $598 late fee unless cleared by that deadline. If first payment fails, immediate service suspension and late fee reinstatement.
Marco (Account Exec): Customer proposed schedule:
INV-2026-1721 total $19,950
1) $6,650 due on agreement (2026-05-06)
2) $6,650 due 2026-06-06
3) $6,650 due 2026-07-06
They asked to waive the late fee if 1st payment posts on time.
Renee (Collections): I'll draft the outbound with those dates and attach the payment-plan addendum. Collections will flip the "pause dunning" flag after card/ACH auth is captured. Add condition: missed 1st payment -> same-day hold + fee reinstatement.
Legal Ops: I'll prepare the short-form addendum, include autopay and default language. Send me the signed schedule once Marco confirms card on file.
Aisha (Finance): Please CC finance when sending. Once first payment clears I'll move the invoice to "on-plan" and update AR aging and cash forecast.
Marco (Account Exec): Call scheduled 5/5 at 11am PT with CFO to collect card auth and e-sign. I'll post signed addendum here after.
BillingBot: Note: recommend manual ACH retry only after authorization received. Current dunning paused internally.
Renee (Collections): If we get auth today, I'll send email immediately and set a monitoring check for 5/7. If payment posts, Collections will request late fee reversal from Finance.
Samir (Finance Director): Approved. Finance will review fee waiver post-clear. Please escalate immediately if first payment is flagged returned.
Marco (Account Exec): Thanks team. I'll follow up after the call. :thumbsup:
